dvb.goal.label: New goal
dvb.goal.action:
set -euo pipefail
output=$(dvb project list)
[[ -n $output ]] || exit 0
mapfile -t projects <<< "$output"
if (( ${#projects[@]} == 1 )); then
  selected=${projects[0]}
else
  selected=$(omarchy-menu-select 'Project' "${projects[@]}") || exit 0
fi
[[ -n $selected ]] || exit 0
read -r name project repo <<< "$selected"
text=$(omarchy-menu-input 'New goal') || exit 0
[[ -n $text ]] || exit 0
if ! out=$(dvb goal "$project" -- "$text" 2>&1); then notify-send dvb "$out"; fi

dvb.answer.label: Answer a question
dvb.answer.action:
set -euo pipefail
output=$(dvb status)
mapfile -t questions < <(printf '%s\n' "$output" | sed -n '/^Needs you: .* ([^()]*)$/p')
(( ${#questions[@]} )) || exit 0
selected=$(omarchy-menu-select 'Answer a question' "${questions[@]}") || exit 0
[[ -n $selected ]] || exit 0
qid=${selected##* (}
qid=${qid%)}
text=$(omarchy-menu-input 'Answer a question') || exit 0
[[ -n $text ]] || exit 0
if ! out=$(dvb answer "$qid" --reply="$text" 2>&1); then notify-send dvb "$out"; fi

dvb.pause.label: Pause everything
dvb.pause.action:
set -euo pipefail
output=$(dvb project list)
[[ -n $output ]] || exit 0
mapfile -t projects <<< "$output"
for selected in "${projects[@]}"; do
  read -r name project repo <<< "$selected"
  dvb pause "$project"
done

dvb.resume.label: Resume everything
dvb.resume.action:
set -euo pipefail
output=$(dvb project list)
[[ -n $output ]] || exit 0
mapfile -t projects <<< "$output"
for selected in "${projects[@]}"; do
  read -r name project repo <<< "$selected"
  dvb resume "$project"
done
